title: Универмаг
purpose: Cartoon style revision of the five shopping mall landmark variants

card_spec.title: Торговый центр
card_spec.rules_text:
Каждое ваше предприятие
с символом «Торговая лавка»
или «Бокал с вилкой»
приносит на 1 монету больше.

generation.prompt: Restyle the FIRST image to be substantially MORE CARTOONISH and less realistic, using the LAST yellow building image as the precise style guide. Preserve the three-storey cream department store with turquoise entrance cylinder, magenta angular upper fascia and mustard side annex, burgundy car and shopping carts. Simplify merchandise behind windows to a few bold color shapes, simplify railings and carts. Remove fine grime and dense cracks. Keep only a few readable wear marks. Car plates must be completely blank. Style reference is the LAST attached image (yellow building). Match its clean cartoon board-game miniature drawing: bold clean outlines, chunky simplified geometry, broad smooth colors, simple soft cel shading, very sparse surface wear. NO photorealistic rendering, NO fine gritty texture, NO intricate shop interiors. Elevated three-quarter view of a compact isolated building on a small paving slab. Building front and right side visible. All content entirely inside frame with generous transparent margins. Genuine RGBA alpha transparency outside the miniature. No backdrop, sky, halo, vignette or cast shadow outside the base. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, pseudo-writing, billboards or license plate marks anywhere. No card furniture, title, price or rules. Keep a few characteristic Russian everyday details but make them chunky and cartoonish, matching the yellow reference building.
